glasses_felix: Pattern of error: High volatility between coffee_table_l1 and bathroom_shelf_ba1. Day 20 data confirms it was at coffee_table_l1 at 09:22, contradicting the assumption it starts on the shelf. Next time: Check coffee_table_l1 first for morning queries; do not assume it is on the shelf until late morning.

tablet_felix: Pattern of error: Inconsistent tracking between desk_b1, coffee_table_l1, and kitchen_table_k1. Day 19 data remains the best guide: coffee_table_l1 for afternoon (12:00-16:00) and kitchen_table_k1 for late afternoon/evening (after 16:00). Avoid desk_b1 for these timeframes.
